english.description: You've survived your first day. As far as accomplishments go, this is certainly one of them.
english.name: HOY_01

english.description: You're really getting the hang of it now... or so you think.
english.name: HOY_04

english.description: There's more to this game than just reading.
english.name: HOY_06

english.description: You've shaken The Huntress' whole world with this decision. Your cruelty is shocking.
english.name: HOY_12

english.description: After everything The Spirit has been through, she has to endure being eliminated, too? You're lucky she doesn't really care about any of this.
english.name: HOY_13

english.description: You sent The Trapper packing? Sleep with both eyes open.
english.name: HOY_14

english.description: What kind of monster eliminates The Wraith? He wouldn't hurt a fly! Please... disregard that skull he's holding.
english.name: HOY_15

english.description: Is that blood on your mask, or are you just happy to see me?
english.name: HOY_21

english.description: Revenge never looked as cute as it does in a sun hat and a black bikini.
english.name: HOY_22

english.description: What is going on in that weird little head of yours? No, actually--I don't even want to know.
english.name: HOY_23

english.description: What's hidden at the heart of this unraveling mystery? There's only one way to find out...
english.name: HOY_24

english.description: You've broken down a mountain into a pile of dusty rocks, then turned your back and walked away. You villain!
english.name: HOY_33

schinese.description: 你活过了第一天，对于成就来说，这肯定算是一个
schinese.name: HOY_01

schinese.description: 你越来越会了... 还是你自己认为的。
schinese.name: HOY_04

schinese.description: 这个游戏可不仅仅就是阅读而已。
schinese.name: HOY_06

schinese.description: 你的决定让女猎手的世界观都崩塌了，你的残酷真的让人震惊。
schinese.name: HOY_12

schinese.description: 在怨灵经历了这么多之后，难道她还要忍受被消灭？你真幸运因为她对这些并不在意。
schinese.name: HOY_13

schinese.description: 你让设陷者去收拾了？睁开眼睛睡觉吧。
schinese.name: HOY_14

schinese.description: 什么样的怪物能灭了幽灵？他都不忍心伤害一个小飞虫。请....别管他手里的骷髅头。
schinese.name: HOY_15

schinese.description: 你的面具上是血吗？还是你仅仅就是因为见我为开心。
schinese.name: HOY_21

schinese.description: 复仇从没像现在这样因为被太阳帽和黑比基尼衬托着而可爱。
schinese.name: HOY_22

schinese.description: 你那奇怪的小脑袋里想什么呢？不，实际上我真不想知道
schinese.name: HOY_23

schinese.description: 是什么藏在这没别揭开的奥秘中？只有一个办法去知道了。
schinese.name: HOY_24

schinese.description: 你把一座大山毁成了一堆石头，之后你就转身走开了，你个坏蛋。
schinese.name: HOY_33

english.description: You have sought glory in ten single-player battles, fight on!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_LOW

english.description: You have fought in one hundred single-player battles!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_MED

english.description: You have fought in one thousand single-player battles!  Even Alexander the Great did not have your strength of will.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_HIGH

english.description: Congratulations!  You have achieved the first multi-player victory of many to come.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_LOW

english.description: You have been victorious in fifty multi-player battles - you are a seasoned veteran and a worthy opponent!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_MEDIUM

english.description: It has probably been a long time since you stopped counting your battles and victories but your fans (and foes) will remember.  This battle marks your five hundredth multi-player victory!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_HIGH

english.description: On this day you have fought in your tenth online battle!  Let the town bell ring and the villagers rest from their labors that they may toast your good health and leadership.   There will be many battles ahead, some victories, some defeats - but always lessons.  Cheers and congratulations to you on this auspicious day!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_MULTI_LOW

english.description: Today is a day of glory!  You have fought one hundred battles versus fierce online opponents.  Three cheers for you - hip hip, HUZZAH!  HUZZAH!  HUZZAH!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_MED

english.description: Today is a day of great celebration!  You have fought your one thousandth battle against online opponents.  Order a feast!  Make a toast to those who have defeated you as honorable teachers, make a toast to those foes you have defeated, and most of all a toast to your friends and allies who have supported you in your many campaigns.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_HIGH

english.description: When you are ready to take on the unexpected you are ready to take on the world.  The Random map challenge is for any who are ready for attack or defense by land or sea and to defend against those who would threaten your empire.    Fight on!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_LOW

english.description: You are master of the random map - from the thrill of exploration, to the skillful deployment of your villages, to the razing of the enemy and driving them from your borders.  Master of continents and oceans, your leadership is the stuff of song and legend!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_MED

english.description: You have fought on every type of map, against every type of opponent in history.  There may be those who will still stand against you, but they do so with respect.  Huzzah!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_HIGH

english.description: With turbo your villagers will gather and build quickly - pay attention to your resources and idle villagers. Turbo will let you focus more on your mid-game strategic planning.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_LOW

english.description: Now that you have played twenty games at turbo you probably have a feel for the pace and challenges.  Focus on pushing your early attacks even earlier to surprise your enemy and interrupt their build momentum.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_MED

english.description: Deathmatch is a competition of fast decisions and instant action.  It will hone your skills at pitched battle.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_LOW

english.description: Mastery of deathmatch is the ability to continuously make good decisions while building a sustainable economy under constant attacks.  You have demonstrated that ability by playing 50 games.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_MED

english.description: After 300 battles if there is something to be learned in Deathmatch it is where to find opponents who will still agree to fight you.  Congratulations!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_HIGH

english.description: Each legendary leader has something to teach you, a tactic, a strategy, or an attitude - when you have fought their battles and studied their history you are taking steps to becoming a legendary leader yourself.  Congratulations!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_LOW

english.description: You have played your twentieth scenario, Congratulations!  What will the historians write about your battles?  Who were your greatest foes?  Were you more cunning or more bold?  Only time will tell.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_MED

english.description: You have played fifty scenarios - Wonderful!  Each conquered world reveals more lessons and more challenges ahead.  All great leaders build their knowledge on the foundation of the stories of the legends that have gone before.   Cheers to you!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_HIGH

english.description: It isn’t taking the hill, it is holding it against all attackers that is the ultimate challenge. You are on your way.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_LOW

english.description: Life is short and brutal but legend is timeless, if you can master the strategies of King of the Hill you will be better prepared to take on anything that life throws at you.  You have battled the hill ten times, this will certainly not be the last.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_MED

english.description: You have claimed one hundred hilltops!  The victor isn’t often the first one to the top, but the one that knows how to hold it once they are there.  You have demonstrated that knowledge.  Cheers to you!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_HIGH

english.description: Wonder race is an exercise in building an economy quickly and efficiently - pay attention to balancing your economy and tasking those villagers and you will be victorious.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_LOW

english.description: By now you know the shortest path to building a wonder quickly - and how to build up your economy in a hurry.  Focus on optimizing your gathering technologies and economy to surprise your opponents.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_MED

english.description: For many, the Wonder Race is a good way to learn how to tune an economy and know the short path to the Wonder for any civilization.  For you, the Wonder Race has its own appeal - a celebration of the empire builder’s art.  Congratulations!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_HIGH

english.description: Wonder Defense is an excellent way for any leader to build their skills.  If you are defending then you must build your forces and reinforce your defensive structures quickly or attack offensively to reduce your opponent’s strength.  Attackers must be coordinated if they hope to succeed.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_LOW

english.description: Few things are so satisfying as seeing the enemy’s wonder in flames, or defending your wonder to the last unit.  After ten Defend the Wonder battles you have certainly seen both.  Cheers to you!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_MED

english.description: You have faced the unknown!  Playing against random opponents will expose you to a world’s worth of variety of units, tactics, and technologies.  Study their strengths and weaknesses to become a great leader.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_LOW

english.description: You have defeated random opponents twenty five times. Your legend grows greater with every victory.  Congratulations!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_MED

english.description: You have faced the random opponents and defeated them two hundred and fifty times.  No civilization can find safety when they stand against you.  Congratulations!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_HIGH

english.description: You have won at least one victory against every civilization in Age of Empires II.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_EVERY_CIV

english.description: You have killed over fifty units in  a single session.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_LOW

english.description: You have killed over 500 units in a single session - your fame will spread from this point onward.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_MED

english.description: You have killed over two thousand units in a single session.  You are a legend to both allies and enemies.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_HIGH

english.description: Sometimes to win battles you have to make hard choices and sacrifices.   In this battle you lost 25 units to combat with the enemy.  Sometimes an outdated unit can get a needed boost of speed or armor with the right technology.   Get used to watching the alerts on your mini-map as well - a second attack is easy to miss once you are defending the first one. Use this tactic to your advantage as well.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_LOW

english.description: Over one hundred of your units were lost in this battle - even with such great losses, if they were well used against the enemy you did the right thing.  Get used to studying the battle stats after each match with an opponent - did you have the right complementary mix of units?  Did you make your enemy pay for every one of your losses?  Every unit sacrificed is an opportunity to learn about your opponent.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_MED

english.description: Two hundred of your units were lost in this conflict.  Sadly, not every battle can be a sweeping victory where everyone returns to the feast table to boast of their skill.   Sometimes, being a good general is about knowing when to throw everything against the enemy without reservation or hesitation.  Today you know how that feels.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_HIGH

english.description: Civilizations can be conquered with ideas as surely as with armaments.  You can celebrate your success this battle in converting enemy units.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_LOW

english.description: The communication of ideas and religion was a powerful force that changed empires in the Middle Ages.  Your conquest of 20 enemies in a single battle shows great skill at deploying and protecting the priests.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_MED

english.description: You have demonstrated mastery of the conversion strategies by converting over fifty enemy units in a single match.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_HIGH

english.description: You razed 50 buildings in this campaign, your enemies will think twice before challenging you again.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_LOW

english.description: In this campaign you razed over 100 buildings, your name is legend among your enemies.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_MED

english.description: No wall nor castle will stand in your way - you have clearly mastered the siege by razing over 250 buildings in one session.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_HIGH

english.description: For some leaders, losing 15 buildings in a single session would be a reason to retreat and resign.  Not you.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_LOW

english.description: For some leaders, losing 50 buildings in a single session would be a crushing defeat - as long as you have wood and villagers you will carry on.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_MED

english.description: Some leaders might aspire to build one hundred buildings in their entire reign.  You lost that many this day and fought on valiantly.  Stay strong!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_HIGH

english.description: You have constructed a wonder - a shining pinnacle of achievement for your civilization.  It is a beacon of hope to people everywhere, and if defended - a legacy of that achievement to stand the test of time.
english.displayName: Creation of your first Wonder of the World
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_LOW

english.description: Few leaders can master both the economy needed to construct a wonder, let alone build a strong military or alliances to defend it.  As a veteran of Five Wonders you have demonstrated those skills.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_MED

english.description: One Wonder is a pinnacle achievement for any ruler.  You have constructed fifty Wonders of the World through your many campaigns through history.  Clearly you are a master of building a strong economy and support structure.  You are clearly a leader in the Age of Empires.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_HIGH

english.description: The Castle was the premiere fortification of the Medieval period.  Your legacy  in the future is assured.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_LOW

english.description: In your various campaigns through history you have constructed over one hundred castles.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_MED

english.description: On this day you have created your thousand’th castle.  Huzzah!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_HIGH

english.description: “We come here with no peaceful intent, but ready for battle, determined to avenge our wrongs and set our country free. Let your masters come and attack us: we are ready to meet them beard to beard.” - (1297) William Wallace
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_WALLACE_COMPLETED

english.description: “Of the love or hatred God has for the English, I know nothing, but I do know that they will all be thrown out of France, except those who die there.” - Joan of Arc (Trial 1431)
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_JOANARC_COMPLETED

english.description: By studying the campaigns of Salah al Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub, or 'Saladin' as he was known to the crusaders, you can know that there are many aspects to the great heroes of the Middle Ages. The lessons of his campaigns will guide you in your other conquests.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SALADIN_COMPLETED

english.description: His enemies know only the ruthlessness and speed of the great Khan’s conquests - but the greatest generals also know the tools of cooperation, alliance, and loyalty - these will serve you well in future campaigns.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_KHAN_COMPLETED

english.description: In study of the campaigns of Frederick Barbarossa you learned the power of relics and of uniting an empire. Use this knowledge in your future conquests, but remember not to overextend yourself.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARBAROSSA_COMPLETED

english.description: Attila knew both great betrayal and great glory in his conquests against the Romans. Attila said: “It takes less courage to criticize the decisions of others than to stand by your own.” - Carry his example on to your other campaigns.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ATTILA_COMPLETED

english.description: Throughout his conquests, El Cid was far more than a master at arms and noble, but was someone who could lead and unite the people. Even beyond his death, the legacy of his leadership was still more powerful than lesser rulers. Take his lessons with you on your own conquests.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELCID_COMPLETED

english.description: By following along with Cuauhtémoc in the battles against Cortés you have used alliance building and subtlety in addition to your skills in battle. Skillful use of forces and alliances can overcome the greatest odds. Remember these lessons in your next conquest.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_MONTEZUMA_COMPLETED

english.description: Through study of these diverse battles and leaders you have mastered skills that will be useful in all of your future conquests. Fight with the piety of Charles Martel, the bravery of Alp Arslan, and the calculating tactics of Hideyoshi to ensure success in your campaigns.
english.displayName: Battles of the Conquerors Campaign Completed
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_CONQUERERS_COMPLETED

english.description: You have successfully completed all of the story campaigns of Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings and Age of Empires II: The Conquerors Expansion. Successful leaders use many techniques to build their empires. Your careful study of the greatest of these men and women has given you new powers and abilities to build future empires.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_AOK_CAMPAIGNS_COMPLETED

english.description: You are an expert at the Turbo style, your decision-making under time pressure is legendary.  Congratulations to you, Lightning General!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_HIGH

english.description: You have led the Spanish to victory one hundred times! Your name will be listed among their greatest heroes.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_SPANISH_HIGH

english.description: You have dedicated yourself to bringing your civilization's religion to your foes.  Very few generals have the patience and wisdom to manage the priest units so effectively as you have.  This is indeed a day of celebration - you have converted one thousand opposing units in your career.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_HIGH

english.description: You have crumbled your five hundredth building into rubble…and you are just getting warmed up.   Congratulations!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_LOW

english.description: You have razed five thousand buildings in your long and illustrious military career!  If your reputation went up as quickly as you take buildings down you would be known world-wide.

english.description: You have razed ten thousand buildings in your long and illustrious military career!  You can unpack trebuchets in your sleep and you consider a dozen fire archers a pleasant introduction.  You are a legend!
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_HIGH

english.description: In your career you have lost over one thousand buildings.  Everything is a milestone, every win, every loss, and every building that falls.  Great generals count their losses and learn from them.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_LOW

english.description: In your career you have lost over ten thousand buildings.  Buildings, like miles spent on horseback are excruciating at first but just mark the passage of time before long.  If you celebrate with a cake, just put one candle on it and start working on your next ten thousand.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_MED

english.description: Sure, generals say that every unit lost is mourned and every building razed is avenged - but after fifty thousand even the most obsessive counter gives up.  You have seen civilizatons rise and fall endlessly - it is time to stop counting the buildings.   Congratulations that you persevere, mighty leader.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_HIGH

english.description: Through toil and perseverance, you have found a new home for Alaric's people, showing even mighty Rome that the Goths are a force to be reckoned with. Use your migratory skills and resilience to find a new home, recover, and succeed in your future aims even when the present looks bleak.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ALARIC_COMPLETED

english.description: Vlad Dracula was a harsh, sometimes cruel ruler, but one could not argue the success of his methods. The only man of his time able to stand against the might of the Ottomans, Vlad showed that patriotism, charisma, and proper tactics could overcome all odds. Vlad also made a point to be strict but fair. Remember that advice when ruling your empire.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_DRACULA_COMPLETED

english.description: The Nautikos family valued its home greatly, and its family history and heritage instilled a drive in its heirs to bring glory to their house. Their exploits, though somewhat forgotten, are a source of pride to their descendants. That pride is a fine attribute, but it is best tempered with prudence and ethic. Take that advice on your future conquests.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARI_COMPLETED

english.description: Rising from a lowly soldier to Duke of Milan, Sforza did more than make his father’s spirit proud. Use the traits of military leadership and tactics that you have learned in this campaign to find success in your future battles, and remember that it is better to be feared than loved. - Machiavelli (The Prince 1513)
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SFORZA_COMPLETED

english.description: Orellana and his loyal followers faced more than their own fears and superstitions on their navigation of the Amazon. To overcome the adversity that stood in their way, they had to work as a unit and not as individuals. Remember those principles of unity and selflessness on your future campaigns.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELDORADO_COMPLETED

english.description: The subject of veneration of many of his descendants, Prithviraj was shrewd, brave, honest, but also prone to emotion, taking many risks for the sake of love. Even in the sight of war and possible death, remember to enjoy your life to the fullest, for you only live once. A complete and moral life deserves the most remembrance.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_PRITHVIRAJ_COMPLETED

english.description: Through your inquiry into the detail of some of the less-known but equally significant historical clashes of arms, you have shown that you are truly a master of the pen and the sword. Rule with the strength of the sons of Ragnar, the diplomatic aptitude of Khosrau Anushirvan, the steadfastness of Minamoto no Yoritomo, and the charisma of Osman Ghazi.
english.displayName: Battles of the Forgotten Campaign Completed
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BATTLES_FORGOTTEN_COMPLETED

english.description: You have successfully completed all of the story campaigns of Age of Empires II: The Forgotten Expansion. Through your trials and successes in these clashes of arms, you surely have mastered all spheres of empire-building and rule, and are ready to start building your own legend. “Cattle die, kindred die, every man is mortal: But the good name never dies of one who has done well.” -Havamal (Poetic Edda 1220)
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_FORGOTTEN_CAMPAIGNS_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 你打了十场单机模式的战斗并且战绩辉煌, 加油!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_LOW

schinese.description: 你打过一百场单机模式的战斗!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_MED

schinese.description: 你已完成一千场单机模式的战斗! 即使是亚历山大帝也没有你那么强的意志力.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_SINGLE_HIGH

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经取得了多人模式的第一场胜利,这是你踏上成功的第一步.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_LOW

schinese.description: 你已经取得了多人模式的第五十场战斗的胜利——你是一位经验丰富的老将和值得尊敬的对手!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_MEDIUM

schinese.description: 你可能很久没有数着自己赢了多少场战斗, 但你的支持者和敌人都会记得. 此战斗标记着你第五百场多人模式对战的胜利!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_NUM_WINS_HIGH

schinese.description: 你今天已经打败了第十次联机对战! 让市镇响钟和村民休息, 庆贺你的强健体魄和军事指挥才能. 将来还有很多场战斗, 会有胜利, 也会有一些失败——但总能学到经验和教训. 让我们为这个值得庆祝的日子欢呼, 为你喝彩!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_MULTI_LOW

schinese.description: 今天是荣耀的一天! 你已经与凶猛的在线对手对抗了一百次. 为您喝彩!——嘿嘿, 万岁! 万岁! 万岁!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_MED

schinese.description: 今天是一个伟大的庆祝活动! 你已经打了一千场与在线对手的战斗. 开一场盛宴吧! 为你尊敬的恩师敬酒, 与被打败的敌人干杯, 最重要是敬酒给支持你活动的所有朋友和盟友.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_HIGH

schinese.description: 如果您已经做好准备, 有能力面对意想不到并超乎寻常的事情, 你就可以独闯天涯了. 随机地图挑战, 是给那些有能力于陆地或海上攻击或防御, 并抵御威胁到自己帝国的人. 加油!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_LOW

schinese.description: 当你完成了第一百张地图的时候, 你将被誉为随机地图大师——从刺激的探索、巧妙地调配村庄, 以至将敌人的领土夷为平地和将他们逐出边界. 统治着不同的大陆和海洋的作战大师, 你的领导已成为歌谣和传说!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_MED

schinese.description: 今天是你的第五百个随机地图游戏. 你大概已经把每个类型的地图和历史上的每一种对手都对战过了. 可能还会有人能对抗你, 但他们都是尊敬你的. 万岁!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_RANDOM_HIGH

schinese.description: 采用增速, 村民能更快地收集和建筑——请注意资源和闲置的村民. 增速能让你更专注于游戏的中期战略规划.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_LOW

schinese.description: 你已经完成了二十场游戏, 相信你也掌握了游戏的步伐和挑战. 你要专注于推动早期攻击, 以突击你的敌人和打断他们造的声势.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_MED

schinese.description: 死斗是一场快速决策和即时行动的比赛. 能于激战磨练你的技能.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_LOW

schinese.description: 精通死斗能让你在建立稳定经济时和受攻击的同时作出正确的决定. 你已完成了五十场游戏, 证明了你拥有此能力.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_MED

schinese.description: 经过三百场战斗之后, 如果你还想从死斗里学到什么新东西, 那就是学习如何找到还胆敢与你对战的人. 恭喜!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEATHMATCH_HIGH

schinese.description: 每个传说领袖都能教会你一些东西, 如策略、策略或态度——当你与他们对战和学习他们的历史, 你已经渐渐迈向成为传说领袖了. 恭喜!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_LOW

schinese.description: 你完成了第二十个场景, 恭喜! 史记会如何记录你的战斗呢？谁是你最大的敌人？你是狡猾还是果断勇敢的？只有时间会告诉我们.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_MED

schinese.description: 你已经完成了五十个场景——太好了! 每一个被征服了的世界会揭示更多的经验和挑战. 所有伟大的领导人把自己的知识基础都建在史前的传说故事. 为你喝彩!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_SCENARIO_HIGH

schinese.description: 占山不是重点, 最终的挑战是要对抗所有的攻击者. 你已经踏出了第一步.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_LOW

schinese.description: 生命是短暂和残酷的, 但传说是永垂不朽的, 如果你能掌握到王者之山的战略, 你会更懂得如何面对生活. 你已经为占领此山战斗了十次, 但肯定不会是最后一次.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_MED

schinese.description: 你已经完成了一百个山峰! 胜利者往往不是第一位到达山峰的人, 但却是懂得如何守卫山峰的人. 你已证明了你懂这个道理. 为你喝彩!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_KINGOFHILL_HIGH

schinese.description: 奇迹比赛是为了练习快速和有效地经济起飞——注意把经济和分配村民的任务做出平衡, 你就可以取得胜利.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_LOW

schinese.description: 现在你已经知道快速构建奇迹的捷径——如何快速地建立你的经济. 专注于你的收集、技术和经济, 令对手感到吃惊.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_MED

schinese.description: 对许多人来说, 奇迹比赛是一个很适合于学习如何调整经济和获取奇迹文明捷径的方法. 对你来说, 奇迹比赛有其特殊的吸引力——这是纪念帝国建造者的一项艺术展现. 恭喜!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WONDERRACE_HIGH

schinese.description: 奇迹防御是一个让任何领导者培养技能的好方式. 如果你在防御, 那么你必须建立你的军队, 并快速加强你的防御建筑物, 或进攻以减少对手的实力. 如果他们希望获得成功, 攻击者必须协调.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_LOW

schinese.description: 最给人成就感的事情, 莫过于看到敌人的奇迹被战火所围困, 或者是保护自己的奇迹直到最后一道纺线. 完成十次防御奇迹的战斗后, 你肯定已经领会了这两种愉悦. 为你喝彩!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_MED

schinese.description: 你已经掌握到防御奇迹的方法. 为你第五十次挑战喝彩!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_DEFENDWONDER_HIGH

schinese.description: 你赢得第一个有价值玩家奖项. 国王时代队战的最有价值玩家把最多的建筑夷为平地和打败了最多的敌人单位. 通过进取的攻击和彻底消除敌人的建筑物, 能增加你赢得最有价值玩家的机会. 恭喜!

schinese.description: 你被选定为最有价值玩家二十次了. 你已表现出战斗里的优秀技能, 并超越了队里的其他将领. 你是这个精英队伍中的后起之秀. 恭喜!

schinese.description: 你已经打败了高丽人二十次.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_KOREANS_MED

schinese.description: 你已经于战斗中打败了高丽人一百次!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_KOREANS_HIGH

schinese.description: 你面临神秘的对手! 与随机对手对战可以让你接触到更多的单位`战术和技术. 研究他们的长处和弱点以成为伟大的领导者.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_LOW

schinese.description: 你战胜了随机对手二十五次. 你的传说随着每一个胜利而增长. 恭喜!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_MED

schinese.description: 你面临和战胜了随机对手二百五十次.面对着你, 没有一个文明能够奢想安宁. 恭喜!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_RANDOM_HIGH

schinese.description: 你对于帝国时代II里面所有的民族都至少打败了他们一次!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_EVERY_CIV

schinese.description: 你在一个阶段里打败了超过五十个单位.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_LOW

schinese.description: 你在一个阶段里打败了五百个单位–你从此声名鹊起了.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_MED

schinese.description: 你在一个阶段里打败了五百个单位. 你对于同盟和敌人而言都是一个神话般的人物.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_KILLED_HIGH

schinese.description: 你偶尔必须做出艰难的抉择和牺牲才能赢得胜利. 在这场战斗中, 你与敌人作战, 失去了二十五个单位. 有时候, 把一个过时的单位加上正确的技术, 就可以提升速度或装甲. 要习惯看着小地图上的警报——在防御第一次攻击的同时, 很容易会忽略了第二次攻击. 也利用这种战术吧.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_LOW

schinese.description: 你在这场战斗中, 损失了超过一百个单位——虽然有如此巨大的损失, 不过如果战术用得对, 他们的牺牲是绝对值得的. 要习惯研究每场对战后的统计数据——你有为不同单位数量做出适合的搭配吗？你有没有让敌人赔偿你的每一个损失？每一个牺牲了的单元, 都是一个了解对手的机会.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_MED

schinese.description: 你在这场战斗中, 损失了超过一百五十个单位. 令人悲伤的是, 不是每一场战斗都能全胜而归, 不是所有人都能安全回来参加庆功宴自夸他们的英勇杀敌事迹的. 有时候, 要当一名英明的将领你就要懂得舍弃, 懂得在适当的时候把一切都毫无保留毫不犹豫地舍弃给对手. 今天, 你知道这是一种什么样的痛了.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_LOST_HIGH

schinese.description: 文明被思想征服, 就像军备一样. 你可以招降敌方单位来庆祝你战斗成功.
schinese.displayName: 沃咯咯——招降了敌军单位
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_LOW

schinese.description: 思想和宗教的沟通是改变了中世纪帝国的强大力量. 你在一场战斗里招降二十个敌人, 表现了部署和保护祭司僧侣高超技巧.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_MED

schinese.description: 你已经掌握了, 在一场战斗中将超过五十个敌方单位招降的策略.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_HIGH

schinese.description: 您在这场征战里将五十座建筑夷为平地, 你的敌人会在再次挑战你之前, 先三思而后行.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_LOW

schinese.description: 您在这场征战里将一百座建筑夷为平地, 你的名字对于你的敌人而言就是噩梦.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_MED

schinese.description: 没有围墙或城堡能阻碍你——你已将超过二百五十座建筑夷为平地, 清楚掌握了攻城战术.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_HIGH

schinese.description: 对于某些领导人来说, 在一个阶段里失去十五座建筑是败退和投降认负的原因. 不过不是你.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_LOW

schinese.description: 对于某些领导人来说, 在一个阶段里失去五十座建筑是一败涂地的. 但只要你有木材和村民, 你就不会放弃.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_MED

schinese.description: 有些领导者, 渴望在他们的整个统治时期, 兴建一百座建筑. 一直英勇战斗的你, 在这一天失去了很多. 要保持坚强!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_HIGH

schinese.description: 你已经建立了一个世界奇观——一个光辉巅峰之夜的文明成就. 对世界各地的人们来说, 这是一盏明灯, 如果捍卫成功——所得的成就, 就能够经得起时间的考验.
schinese.displayName: 建立你的第一个世界奇观
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_LOW

schinese.description: 很少领导人能掌握到建造世界奇观的所需经济, 更别说要建立一个要捍卫它的强大军团. 作为一个筑造了五个世界奇观的老将, 你证明了你自己有这些技能.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_MED

schinese.description: 一个世界奇观对任何统治者来说, 就是成就的巅峰. 通过一直以来的征战, 你已经建造了五十个世界奇观. 你显然是发展处强大经济和相应防御工事的高手. 你名副其实是帝国时代的领导者.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_WONDERS_BUILT_HIGH

schinese.description: 城堡是中世纪时期的最大防御建筑. 你的未来遗产得到了保障.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_LOW

schinese.description: 在你过去的各种活动中, 你建造了超过一百座城堡.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_MED

schinese.description: 在这一天, 你成功建造了第一千座城堡. 万岁!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CASTLES_BUILT_HIGH

schinese.description: '我们来这里并没有和平意图, 而是做好了战斗的准备, 决心要向我们的敌人报复, 令我们的国家自由. 让你们的主人放马过来攻击我们吧：我们已经准备好和他们斗个你死我活. '——(1297)威廉——华莱士
schinese.displayName: 已完成威廉·华莱士征战
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_WALLACE_COMPLETED

schinese.description: “对于上帝赐予英国人的爱和恨, 我毫不知情, 但我知道它们都会被赶出法国, 除了那些死在那里的. ”–圣女贞德(1431年临行前)
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_JOANARC_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 透过学习萨拉·赫·丁·阿布·拉·穆扎费尔·优素福·伊本·阿玉璧·伊本·沙迪, 或十字军所谓的"萨拉丁"带领的征战, 你就知道古代伟大的英雄有许多值得学习的地方. 他征战的经验教训, 可以引导你征服成功.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SALADIN_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 他的敌人只知道成吉思汗的征服是残酷且快速的——但最伟大的将军也知道, 合作、联盟和忠诚是最好的手段——这些能够在未来征战里, 助你一把.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_KHAN_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 在研究腓特烈巴巴罗萨的征战中, 你学会了圣物的力量和帝国的团结. 在你未来的征服里, 运用这方面的知识.
schinese.displayName: 已完成腓特烈巴巴罗萨征战
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARBAROSSA_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 阿蒂拉知道他对罗马的征服, 夹杂着背叛和荣耀. 阿蒂拉说：「批评别人的决定比坚持自己的想法需要较少的勇气. 」——要以他作为榜样, 套用到其它征战之中.
schinese.displayName: 已完成阿蒂拉·匈奴的征战
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ATTILA_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 纵观他的征服, 爱尔席德不只是血腥和高贵的化身, 更是一位能领导和团结人民的人. 甚至在他去世之后, 他的统治所遗留下来的余威, 都比其他统治者更强大. 要把他的经验教训, 套用到自己的征途上.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELCID_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 在追随着瓜特穆斯对抗科尔特斯的战斗里, 除了战斗, 你还使用了联盟建筑和暗鬥的技能. 熟练地使用部队和联盟, 可以克服各种难题. 要在下一次的征服里, 记得这些经验教训.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_MONTEZUMA_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 通过研究这些不同的战斗和领导者, 你已经掌握了对你未来的征服有帮助的技能.
schinese.displayName: 已完成征服者的战斗征战
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_CONQUERERS_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 你已成功完成所有的国王时代和帝国时代：征服者的故事征战. 成功的领导者会运用许多技术来建立自己的王国. 你对各朝各代风流人物英雄往事的仔细研究, 给了你全新的能力去建立未来帝国.
schinese.displayName: 中世纪世界的作战大师
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_AOK_CAMPAIGNS_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 你是增速模式专家, 你在时间压力下做决策的能力是举国闻名的. 恭喜你, 闪电将军!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_GAMES_PLAYED_TURBO_HIGH

schinese.description: 你带领着西班牙人战胜了一百次! 你的名字将被列入他们最伟大的英雄.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_SPANISH_HIGH

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了一个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度).
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_1

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了两个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度).
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_2

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了三个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度).
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_3

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了四个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度).
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_4

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了五个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度).
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_5

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了六个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度). 没有多少人可以达到这个级别的技能.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_6

schinese.description: 恭喜! 你已经击败了七个电脑对手(在中等或更高的难度). 没有多少人可以达到这个级别的技能.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_DEFEATED_CPU_OPPONENTS_7

schinese.description: 每一个成功的招降, 对你的队伍有双倍利益——消灭敌人的攻击者, 并增加自己的力量. 在你的职业生涯中, 你已经成功招降五十个单位.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_LOW

schinese.description: 在你的职业生涯中, 你已经成功招降五百个单位!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_MED

schinese.description: 你带给敌人你文明的宗教. 很少将军有耐性和智慧去管理祭司单位管理得像你那么有效. 这的确是一个值得庆祝的日子——你的职业生涯里已经招降了一千个单位.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_UNITS_CONVERTED_CAREER_HIGH

schinese.description: 你已经把第五百座建筑变成了一片废墟...你才刚热身呢. 恭喜!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_LOW

schinese.description: 在光亮的军事生涯里, 你已经将五千座建筑夷为平地! 如果你的名声, 就像你破坏建筑的速度一样快, 相信全世界都会认识你.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_MED

schinese.description: 在璀璨的军事生涯里, 你已经将一万座建筑夷为平地! 你可以在梦中解开投石机, 十几个火弓箭手对你来说, 只是一个好玩的热身. 你是一个传说!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_RAZED_CAREER_HIGH

schinese.description: 在你的戎马生涯中你失去了一千座建筑. 每一步, 每一场胜利, 每一场失败, 每一座建筑的倒塌, 都是一座里程碑. 英明的将军会反省他们的失败并从其中找到教训而提高自己.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_LOW

schinese.description: 在你的戎马生涯中你失去了一万座建筑. 建筑的倒塌, 就和你在马背上度过的那些岁月一般, 一开始是辛酸的, 但是后来它们对你而言只是细数的光阴流逝的见证而已. 如果你要用蛋糕来庆祝的话, 那么就请插上一只蜡烛, 然后开始为你的下一个一万座建筑而努力吧!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_MED

schinese.description: 是的, 将士们都说每一个死去的士兵都令人忧伤, 每一座被摧毁的建筑让你想到复仇——但是当五万座建筑倒下之后, 即使最执着的人也不想再去一一回顾了. 你见过文明复兴后又没落, 没落后又复兴, 没有尽头, 现在是时候不去细数那些倒下的建筑了. 祝贺你, 坚韧不拔, 所向披靡的将军!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_BUILDINGS_LOST_CAREER_HIGH

schinese.description: 你第一次主办了多人游戏!
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_HOSTED_GAME

schinese.description: 通过不懈的努力和跋涉, 你为阿拉里克的子民建立了新家园, 向强大的罗马宣告, 哥特是值得尊重的一个民族. 即便前方看不到希望和光明, 你仍利用你的移民本领和坚韧不拔的能力去找到一个新家园, 休整、回复, 并在未来的战斗中一步步走向胜利.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ALARIC_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 弗拉德·德古拉是一个严厉甚至残酷的统治者, 但是他的手段确实有效. 作为那个时代唯一一个能和强大的奥斯曼帝国相抗衡的人物, 弗拉德的一生表面了忠诚、号召力和合适的战术可以创造奇迹. 弗拉德制定了严酷但是公平的规则. 等你统治你的国家的时候可别忘了他当时的意见.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_DRACULA_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 诺蒂卡斯家族一心光耀门楣, 他们的基因里有着辉煌的过去. 他们的曾经的壮举即便有一部分已无法记起, 也会被一代代传承下去. 他们自豪而不自大, 品行谨慎而高尚. 你在未来的征途里最好不要忘了他们的经验和教训.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BARI_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 从一个低级士兵一步步爬上米兰公爵的王座, 斯福尔扎不仅仅只是发扬了他父亲的精神, 还开创了自己的江山. 你要把从这个战役里学到的军事领导才能和战术指挥能力应用到你未来的南征北战当中. “与其让人民畏惧你, 不如让他们爱戴你. ” —— 出自马基亚维利 (1513年) 的《君主论》
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_SFORZA_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 奥雷利亚纳和他忠诚的追随者面对的不仅仅是自己在亚马逊征途上的恐惧和迷信. 为了克服一路上的种种艰险, 他们必须上下同心而不能各顾各安危. 你在未来的战役中也要记得这种团结一致和无私奉献的原则.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_ELDORADO_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 作为诸多后人的敬仰的对象, 布里陀毗罗阇精明、勇敢、诚实, 但也是容易意气用事的, 他曾为了爱情赴汤蹈火. 即便在战争和死亡的威胁前, 你都要懂得最大限度地享受你的人生, 因为人只能活一次. 一段完整而高尚的人生是最值得回忆的.
schinese.displayName: 完成布里陀毗罗阇战役
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_PRITHVIRAJ_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 通过亲身经历了那些不为世人所知但在历史上却非常重要的大战争, 你证明了你自己确实文韬武略样样精通. 今后你可以用狮心王的力量、霍斯劳的外交手腕、源赖朝的毅力和奥斯曼的人格魅力来一统天下了.
schinese.displayName: 完成失落帝国战役集锦
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_CAMPAIGN_BATTLES_FORGOTTEN_COMPLETED

schinese.description: 你成功通过了帝国时代II:失落帝国里的所有战役. 在这些征战中你通过不断地尝试和突破, 肯定掌握了所有打江山和受江山需要的本领, 也可以开始书写你自己的传奇故事了. “畜生会死, 家族会亡, 没有人是能永生的——但是成就伟业的那些人的名字会和历史一起流传下去. ”——出自1220年《诗体埃达》中的第二首《高人的箴言》.
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_ALL_FORGOTTEN_CAMPAIGNS_COMPLETED
